# Synthetic warning demo executed on hardware

2026-10-17, warning_bench-v1. The test operator confirmed panel battery on, both USBs
connected and panel dark. The existing persistent COM session received one
`demo-warning` command without reset/reopening. This excerpt is captured console
output from the actual ESP32, but **all displayed speeds are synthetic**, not
radar measurements. It is not raw UART data or evidence of speed accuracy.

The log shows 18 MPH numeric, 25 MPH warning/flashing/SLOW_DOWN, sample expiry
with fresh=0/mph=-1/warning=0/BLANK during simulated silence, numeric recovery,
empty-report blanking and WARNING_ENDED. Input counters remain invalid=0,
errors=0, backlogs=0. The step logger reports kind changes only, so the 29-to-40
km/h change within kind=Speed has no separate DEMO_STAGE line; the MPH=25 status
confirms the later stage. Enum: 0 title, 1 speed, 2 silence, 3 empty, 4 end.

The test operator subsequently confirmed the numbers, flashing, SLOW / DOWN, blanking and
return to darkness looked correct. This is a visual pass of the indoor synthetic
trial. The full source capture is retained privately. Excerpt preserves original line
order and content, with only CRLF-to-LF normalization and boundary trimming.
